name: k8gb-deterministic-reconciliation-planning-7328
instr:
k8gb cannot preview or reject reconciliation effects before Kubernetes writes become visible. Build deterministic planning, policy decisions, and application for Gslb, ZoneDelegation, legacy migration, and CoreDNS reconciliation. With enforcement disabled, preserve existing outputs, behavior, migration choices, ordering, requeues, and Prometheus collector registration.

Equivalent readable state must produce identical request and controller identity, terminal disposition, and dependency-ordered operations, with stable collection-derived ordering. Every plan reports the native error, requeue, stop, or no-op disposition. Planning must not change objects, status, ownership, finalizers, endpoints, or events.

Represent every direct or collaborator-mediated mutation with its actual desired value. Preserve object, status-subresource, ownership, replacement, conversion, CoreDNS, lifecycle, and event meaning. Decide complete plans under allow, preview, or reject policy before operations become visible. Incomplete and rejected plans have no partial effects. Apply allowed operations in order, matching ordinary reconciliation from equivalent state.

`Planner`, `Policy` with `Mode PolicyMode`, and `Decision` with `PlanID string; Outcome DecisionOutcome` are public from `github.com/k8gb-io/k8gb/controllers/reconcileplan`. From `github.com/k8gb-io/k8gb/controllers`, `GslbReconciler.Plan`, `ZoneDelegationReconciler.Plan`, `LegacyGslbMigrationReconciler.Plan`, and `CoreDNSReconciler.Plan` ea
